schema_description: Resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar for diversity-consensus-sweep.json (per-condition consensus-sweep cells). The sibling diversity-analysis-report.json records explicit metadata (metadata.n_bootstrap=1000, metadata.random_seed=42, metadata.n_permutations=10000); this sidecar mirrors that specification for the consensus-sweep file.

notes: Consensus-sweep cells lack in-file metadata; the sibling diversity-analysis-report.json from the same run records the full spec. Same-run invariance assumed.
